name: Ahiah
overview: The name Ahiah appears in Scripture associated with different individuals who served distinct roles within Israel's history. One Ahiah was a grandson of Phinehas and connected to the priestly line in Shiloh, indicating a heritage tied to the LORD's service (1 Samuel 14:3). Another Ahiah was a scribe under King Solomon, serving in an administrative capacity alongside Elihoreph (1 Kings 4:3). Additionally, an Ahiah is identified as a Benjamite, highlighting the name's presence across tribal lines (1 Chronicles 8:7). These references collectively illustrate Ahiah's association with both spiritual and governmental functions in Israel's history.
